name: OpenStreetMap Nominatim
description: Search, reverse-geocode, and look up OSM features using a self-hosted or licensed Nominatim-compatible API. Requires an operator-supplied endpoint. The public nominatim.openstreetmap.org service cannot be embedded as generic place search in an agent platform under its usage policy.

credential_fields.name: nominatim_base_url
credential_fields.label: Nominatim API base URL
credential_fields.description: HTTPS base URL of your self-hosted or licensed Nominatim-compatible service, without /search or /reverse. Do not use the public nominatim.openstreetmap.org endpoint for this general-purpose integration.

tools.name: search_place
tools.description: Search an address or named place. Returns OSM IDs, coordinates, display names, address details and extra tags where available. Nominatim search is for resolving a specific place, not collecting all restaurants in an area; use Overpass for POI discovery.

q.description: Specific place name or address, for example Baba Nahm, Madrid.

countrycodes.description: Optional comma-separated ISO country codes, for example es or es,pt.

tools.name: reverse_geocode
tools.description: Resolve a coordinate to its nearest mapped address or place. The nearest result is not proof that a business occupies that point.

tools.name: lookup_osm_feature
tools.description: Look up an exact OSM node, way or relation by prefixed ID, for example N123, W456 or R789. Returns extra tags where the Nominatim service has indexed them.

osm_ids.description: One prefixed OSM ID: N for node, W for way, R for relation.
